about.title: About Us
about.description:
Hi! My name is Paweł Tuszkiewicz and I have been working in the world of technology and vending for over 15 years. I have always been drawn to things that others consider 'unfixable' – I like solving problems where most people give up.

VendingTech is the result of this passion. I wanted to create a company that combines a practical approach with openness to new technologies. I don't operate according to rigid schemes – I treat vending machines as a space for experimenting and implementing improvements that really make a difference. I use my own projects, unconventional solutions, and knowledge gained from years of working with various systems.

Outside of vending, I create flying models and engage in technological projects that develop my skills and allow me to look at technology from a different perspective.

If you're looking for a company that combines experience with a flexible approach and real commitment to every project – we invite you to work with us.

services_page.title: Our Services
services_page.service.title: VENDING MACHINE SERVICE
services_page.service.description:
Consulting and sales: We provide professional advice of vending machines, adapting them to the specific location and user needs.

Transport and assembly: We provide safe transport and professional configuration of devices on site.

Service and technical support: We offer ongoing maintenance, repair of cooling systems, replacement of consumables and delivery of components on request, operating in the Silesia region.
services_page.print3d.title: 3D PRINTING AND CUSTOM DESIGNS
services_page.print3d.description:
3D printing and custom part design: With an advanced technological background, we offer: 3D printing from submitted files (STL, OBJ, 3MF, and others), 3D model design from scratch – based on sketches, technical drawings, or descriptions.

Printing: We operate on a Prusa XL printer equipped with:
➔ Large working area: 35 × 35 cm
➔ The ability to print in five colors (or five different materials) simultaneously

We produce, among others:
➔ Technical and spare parts
➔ Prototypes and custom components
➔ Enclosure elements, adapters, mounts

Technology and materials: We print using FDM technology with a wide range of materials (PLA, PETG, ABS).

Verification: Before production, each model undergoes verification for feasibility and compliance with printing technology.
